training_seed_roles: 0 and 1 identify separately initialized and optimized training runs.
evaluation_seed_roles: 1001/1002/1003 identify evaluation initial-condition streams, not extra training replicates.
statistical_limit: Episode-level Wilson intervals describe conditional evaluation sampling for a fixed checkpoint, assuming binomial observations. Repeated episodes share environments and the same trained policy; these intervals do not quantify population training-seed variance. Two training seeds allow descriptive comparison only.
first_success_limit: First-success timing is conditional on ever-success episodes; failed episodes are not assigned zero or finite first-success times.
seed2_recommendation: Run one separately authorized fresh training seed2 with all scientific settings frozen to add an independent replicate; do not launch automatically or adapt hyperparameters.
